metadata.title: Tech Stocks Slide With Bond Yields at Decade Highs - WSJ

content.text:
Stocks are in the red and borrowing costs around the world are at multiyear highs, as investors fret over heavy fiscal spending and inflation.
The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield is hovering near 5.3% after hitting a 19-year intraday high earlier in the day; Japanese long-dated yields are close to a record high. One factor pushing up bond yields: The capital-hungry AI industry’s huge appetite for debt, which puts it in competition with traditional nation-state borrowers.
